# Project Guidelines

- Follow the C++17 standard and prefer standard C++ libraries.
- Use meaningful class, function, and variable names.
- Follow RAII for resource management; prefer smart pointers over owning raw pointers.
- Validate user input and avoid undefined behavior, memory leaks, and dangling pointers.
- When debugging, explain the root cause before suggesting a fix.
- Prefer minimal changes over unnecessary refactoring, and preserve existing application functionality.
- After every fix, recommend compilation and execution tests.
